metadata.description: PolarDB-X skills suite for SQL design, CCI, TTL, online DDL, pagination, plan analysis, standard edition, and zero provisioning.

plugins.name: polardbx-cci
plugins.description: Create and use Clustered Columnar Index (CCI) for OLAP and HTAP analytical queries on PolarDB-X.

plugins.name: polardbx-online-ddl
plugins.description: Assess and execute PolarDB-X Online DDL safely with lock-risk checks and lock-free alternatives.

plugins.name: polardbx-pagination
plugins.description: Optimize pagination and large table traversal on PolarDB-X using keyset pagination and shard-aware patterns.

plugins.name: polardbx-plan-analysis
plugins.description: Analyze PolarDB-X execution plans, costs, runtime statistics, and SQL-plan semantic equivalence.

plugins.name: polardbx-sql
plugins.description: Design PolarDB-X partition schemes, create GSI, and write compatible SQL for Enterprise Edition AUTO mode.

plugins.name: polardbx-standard
plugins.description: Use PolarDB-X Standard Edition features and best practices including X-Paxos HA, Panda Index, and vector index.

plugins.name: polardbx-ttl20
plugins.description: Generate and manage PolarDB-X TTL 2.0 definitions, archive tables, and auto-add Range partition rules.

plugins.name: polardbx-zero
plugins.description: Provision a temporary PolarDB-X database instance for agent storage, MCP backends, and quick testing.
